summary: A printable test in two files built from one layout: the pupil copy (head with a ruled name and score strip, numbered questions with four options A to D, and when asked written questions with answer boxes, parallel variants, DTM-style combinations, matching and a reading passage) and the teacher copy (the same sheets plus the key on its own last pages). BSB and CHSB papers are printed as the customer names them, with a marking-criteria table in the key.
tone: Neutral school-exam register: impersonal stems that are complete questions or exam imperatives (aniqlang, toping, belgilang, yozing, tanlang); no address to the reader outside the template's fixed instruction line.
title: model

length.note: The customer names questions, not pages: 20 questions are 3 pages and one page of key. A page count in the message is read only when no question count is.

fields.where: Head: first line of the title ("Subject, N-sinf"); running head; key page subtitle.
Head: after the subject in the title line; also sets the difficulty and the type step (classes 1-4 start at the loose step). Omitted from the head when unknown.
Head: italic topic line under the title; read from an attached file when there is one; running head.

label.uz: Ish turi (test, nazorat ishi, BSB, CHSB)
label.en: Kind of paper (test, class test, BSB, CHSB)

fields.where: Head: the tracked-capitals kind line. TEST, NAZORAT ISHI (КОНТРОЛЬНАЯ РАБОТА, CLASS TEST) and YOZMA SAVOLLAR are fixed words; BSB and CHSB have no fixed word in any language: the line is the customer's own text with its number exactly as typed (2-BSB, BSB-2, ЧСБ-1), never expanded. Missing means the plain word TEST.

Numbering, the "/ N" total in the pupil strip, the key strips. The count is PER VARIANT. Missing means 20. At most 40 questions in the whole document: when count x variants is over 40 the pipeline writes floor(40 / variants) per variant and the delivery caption says so.

Variant badge in the head, one sheet per variant (page numbers and question numbers restart in each), one key per variant on the key pages. Missing means one variant, no badge. The question count is per variant.

label.uz: Savol turlari (yopiq, yozma, DTM, matn, juftlash)
label.ru: Типы вопросов (закрытые, письменные, ДТМ, текст, соответствие)
label.en: Question types (closed, written, DTM, text, matching)

example.uz: 15 ta test va 3 ta yozma savol

fields.where: Part I / Part II headings, statement lists, passage block, written answer boxes. Missing means choice questions only.
When given, the AI sets the marks so that they add up to exactly this number. Otherwise the renderer adds up the marks. Printed as "Ball: / N" in the pupil strip and in the key.

Key pages: grade scale table with point ranges computed from the total. Drawn only when the customer asks for it or gives the bands; never a default, not even for BSB and CHSB (the 0-29 / 30-65 / 66-85 / 86-100 bands convert the accumulated quarter score, see doc 9).
Head: the small tracked-capitals line over the kind line. Never invented; the line and its space vanish when missing.

Head: "2-NAZORAT ISHI" (bare hyphen) / "КОНТРОЛЬНАЯ РАБОТА № 2" / "CLASS TEST 2" in the kind line, and the italic term line under it in the customer's words. For BSB/CHSB the number stays where the customer put it (2-BSB or BSB-2).

label.uz: Qayerda foydalaniladi (sinfda chop etish yoki o‘zim tayyorlanish)
label.ru: Для чего (печать в классе или самоподготовка)

fields.where: Self-study removes the pupil strip and the Ball/Baho cells and turns the key into letter plus one-line explanation. Missing means class print.

label.uz: Qo‘shimchalar (javoblar varaqasi, yechim uchun joy, izohli kalit)
label.ru: Дополнения (бланк ответов, место для решения, ключ с пояснениями)
label.en: Extras (answer sheet, working space, explained key)

fields.where: Answer sheet at the end of the pupil part; working boxes for written items (strictly opt-in: only when the customer asks for room for the solution, because many control works are written in a notebook); explanations in the key.
Not drawn. Every question must be answerable from them; no citation line is printed in a test.

label.ru: Фамилия, имя, класс и дата ученика

fields.where: Pupil strip: the name row (F.I.Sh. across the full width, about 150 mm of writing room) and the Sinf and Sana cells, always empty. The strip is a convention of teacher worksheets, not an evidenced part of any reputable paper in the set, so one phrase drops it ("F.I.Sh. satrisiz", "без строки для фамилии", "no name line"): the pupil cells vanish and the teacher's cells stay alone on one right-aligned row. Off for self-study.

Strip: Ball ("/ N") and Baho cells, two heavier empty cells; for BSB and CHSB only the Ball cell, because the mark comes from the converted quarter score (doc 9). A score tab under every written item. Always empty.

parts.write: Nothing to write: the head is drawn from the subject, class, topic, kind, school and term facts, each as the customer wrote it.

heading.ru: Фамилия, имя · Класс · Дата · Балл · Оценка

parts.write: Nothing to write: ruled cells for the pupil’s name, class and date and the score and mark; left out for self-study.
Nothing to write: the template builds the instruction sentences (one correct answer, the time, points) from the facts.

heading.en: Part I. Choose the correct answer

parts.write: The closed questions: a complete stem, four options, the correct option’s text copied into answer, a one-sentence explanation, marks 1. Numbered through the whole paper; about ten a page after the first.

Only when asked, when the subject is reading-based, or when a source file is attached: a short title and 60 to 120 words, original or a paraphrase of the attached source, followed by 3 to 6 questions that need the text. The reference line "9-11-savollarga matn asosida javob bering." is made by the renderer.

Only when asked (yozma, ochiq, BSB, CHSB, nazorat ishi): a stem, its marks, a model answer of one to four sentences or the solution steps, and a rubric whose lines add up to the marks, a proposal for the teacher, never an official scheme.
Nothing to write: empty numbered cells for the choice questions, only when asked.
Nothing to write: the key letters are drawn from the answers on the last page.

heading.uz: Yozma savollar: namunaviy javoblar va baholash
heading.ru: Письменные вопросы: образец ответов и оценивание
heading.en: Written questions: model answers and marking

parts.write: Nothing to write here: the model answers and rubrics of the written questions are drawn from those questions.
Nothing: the grading-scale table is deferred.

rules.text: One language per test, the customer’s; Uzbek in Latin only, o‘ and g‘ with ‘ and the tutuq with ’. Fixed labels are the template’s, never typed. BSB and CHSB are never expanded, and no paper is called official or from the ministry.
The head is only what the customer said: subject, class, topic, kind. Never a school, teacher, date, time limit or point total they did not give.

Write exactly the number of questions asked, 20 when none is named, at most 40, numbered 1 to N. One variant only. A page count without a question count means about ten questions a page after the first.
Every closed question has exactly four options and exactly one correct one. After your own final ordering of the options, copy the text of the correct option exactly into answer.

Options share one grammatical form and a similar length; correct letters are spread over A to D, never three in a row; wrong options are plausible. Never «all of the above» or «A and B»; numbers in ascending order.

The stem is complete and answerable on its own, one idea, no hint inside it, never a picture or graph that is not on the page (give the data in words). A negative stem in at most one question in ten, its negative word in capitals. Difficulty rises: recall, application, reasoning.

Facts are textbook-level and certain; with attached files every correct answer is found in them. Without one, a date, name or number only when certain. Never a quotation, law, statistic or source of your own.
Work every numeric answer out step by step first; wrong numeric options come from plausible mistakes. Formulas in plain characters (x², H₂SO₄, ½, 3/4, √(x+1)); ∠ △ ⊥ ∥ ∈ ⊂ are said in words.
DTM style only when asked: 5 to 8 statements «1) …», options are distinct combinations, one fully correct. Matching only when asked, options like «1-c, 2-d, 3-a».

Written questions only when asked: marks as stated, else 2 for a short answer and 3 or 4 for an extended one, adding up to a total given; a model answer or the solution steps and a rubric whose lines add up to the marks, a proposal, never called official.

A passage only when asked, for a reading-based subject or with a source attached: 60 to 120 words with a short title, then 3 to 6 questions that need it, topic «passage», after the other closed questions.
An explanation is one sentence of at most 20 words. The level follows the class. A gap is six underscores. Quotation marks “ ” in Uzbek and English, « » in Russian.

prompt.uz:
✍️ Bitta xabarda yozing: fan, sinf, mavzu va savollar soni (40 tagacha, aytilmasa 20).
➕ Ixtiyoriy: turi (test, nazorat ishi, BSB, CHSB), vaqt, maktab nomi, yozma savollar.
📎 Darslik yoki konspektni (PDF, Word, TXT) biriktirsangiz, savollar shundan tuziladi.
✅ Kalitlar faylning oxirgi sahifasida.
prompt.ru:
✍️ Опишите одним сообщением: предмет, класс, тему и число вопросов (до 40, без числа — 20).
➕ По желанию: вид (тест, контрольная, БСБ, ЧСБ), время, название школы, письменные вопросы.
📎 Прикрепите учебник или конспект (PDF, Word, TXT) — вопросы составлю по нему.
✅ Ключи — на последней странице файла.
prompt.en:
✍️ Say it all in one message: subject, class, topic and number of questions (up to 40, 20 if you don’t say).
➕ Optional: kind (test, class test, BSB, CHSB), time limit, school name, written questions.
📎 Attach a textbook or your notes (PDF, Word, TXT) and I’ll write the questions from them.
✅ The key is on the last page of the file.

examples.uz: 7-sinf biologiya, “Hujayra tuzilishi” mavzusi bo‘yicha test kerak: 15 ta savol, 4 tadan javob. Vaqt — 30 daqiqa.
examples.ru: Нужен тест по биологии для 7 класса, тема «Строение клетки»: 15 вопросов, у каждого 4 ответа на выбор. Время — 30 минут.
examples.en: A biology test for year 7 on cell structure: 15 questions, four options each. Time limit: 30 minutes.

examples.uz: 6-sinf matematika, “Kasrlar” bobi bo‘yicha 2-BSB kerak: 10 ta test savoli va 3 ta yozma savol. Yozma savollar uchun namunaviy javob va baholash mezonini yozing.
examples.ru: Нужна 2-БСБ по математике для 6 класса, раздел «Дроби»: 10 тестовых и 3 письменных вопроса. К письменным — образец ответа и критерии оценивания.
examples.en: A 2-BSB in mathematics for year 6, chapter “Fractions”: 10 choice questions and 3 written ones, with a model answer and marking criteria for each written question.

examples.uz: O‘zim tayyorlanish uchun DTM uslubida tarix testi kerak: “Amir Temur davri” mavzusida 30 ta savol, ilova qilgan konspektim asosida. Javoblarga qisqa izoh yozing.
examples.ru: Хочу подготовиться к ДТМ: тест по истории в стиле ДТМ, тема «Эпоха Амира Темура», 30 вопросов по моему прикреплённому конспекту. К ответам — короткие пояснения.
examples.en: I’m preparing for the DTM: 30 history questions in the DTM style on the age of Amir Temur, based on the notes I attached. Add a short explanation to each answer.

finished.uz: 📄 Test tayyor. Kalitlar oxirgi sahifada: o‘quvchilarga tarqatishdan oldin uni ajratib oling.
finished.ru: 📄 Тест готов. Ключи — на последней странице: отделите её перед раздачей ученикам.
finished.en: 📄 Your test is ready. The key is on the last page: take it off before handing the test out.

blanks.uz: Siz bermagan ma’lumot o‘rniga bo‘sh joy qoldirildi: uni o‘zingiz to‘ldiring.
blanks.ru: Где данных не было, оставлены пустые места: заполните их сами.
blanks.en: Where you gave no details, blanks were left for you to fill in.

pool.uz: 8-sinf kimyo, “Kislotalar” mavzusida 10 ta savollik test. Maktab: 14-maktab.
pool.ru: Тест по химии для 8 класса, тема «Кислоты», 10 вопросов. Школа № 14.
pool.en: A chemistry test for grade 8 on acids, 10 questions. School No. 14.

gates: A native speaker reads the instruction sentences (one_answer, time, point_each, self_study) and the part headings in uz, ru and en against section 4.3 of units/pdf.test/template.md.
A sample of 20 and of 40 questions in each language is rendered and every key letter is checked against its question by a person.
The facts corpus is at zero on this entry’s examples, and one real-provider run (scripts/operations/ai_smoke.py --category pdf.test) is read before the tick.

later.text: Variants (I and II) with a badge and a key per variant: this round writes one variant; a message that asks for variants gets one and the review says so.
Two files (pupil copy and teacher copy): this round delivers one file with the key on its own last page.
Working boxes for written answers ("room for working").
The delivery file names of bot.delivery (the product names a result in apps/core/naming.py).
Recomputing numeric answers in code, a blind verification call that solves every item, BSB and CHSB criteria columns, the self-study explained key.
The grading-scale table (percent bands turned into points): the part grade_scale is retired until its block is built.
